checks: The chosen edge endpoints project to one site. The remaining two sites together with it are affinely independent, since otherwise all four tetrahedron vertices would lie in the affine plane over one projected line.

At a projected point the two nonedge barycentric coefficients are fixed, and the two edge coefficients sum to the remaining projected coefficient. Varying only that split gives the lower and upper affine interpolations, including all projection-boundary points.

Subtracting the appropriate affine height is globally invertible and sends each chord exactly to its lower- or upper-aligned version. It bijects the containing closed halfspaces and scales body and cap volumes by the same factor.
